title: Biomimetic Scaffold Design for Extracellular Matrix Mimicry: From Decellularization to 3D Bioprinting in Tissue Engineering and Drug Development
description: A comprehensive analysis of advanced strategies for designing extracellular matrix (ECM)-mimicking scaffolds for tissue engineering and regenerative medicine. The article explores ECM biology, details methodologies like decellularization and bioprinting, and covers applications in tissue regeneration and creating tumor models for drug screening, while also addressing challenges in optimization and standardization.
audience: Researchers, Biomedical Engineers, Drug Development Professionals
